L11·N8649unmasked layer

L31·N4172unmasked layer
This neuron has no clean semantic trigger; it fires weakly and diffusely on mid-phrase "connector" tokens that sit inside a predictable multi-token collocation or name (the subword "au" in Spand|au, the "an" in "open an account", "more" before "Mendota alumni", "non" in "non-grazed", "%," in a color list), and is strongly suppressed on tokens that close a noun phrase (e.g., "own" in "their own", "inn" in "budget inn", the "T" of "TBC", a year's leading digit).

L31·N6415unmasked layer
